notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 14, 2025)
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]

- Improved ramp and bowl physics for smoother transitions.
- Multiplier now consistently stops when the mop is dirty.
- Refreshed main menu with a cleaner look.

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 14, 2025)
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]

- Added a new UI display showing points earned per cleaned spot, making multiplier mechanics clearer.
- Clicking "Next" now clears the daily score, just like RB and LB.
- Added extra soap locations in Warehouse & Subway (Free Mop).
- Minor optimizations for smoother performance.
- Buckets now give an instant boost upon contact.
- Increased dirt points from 500 → 2500.
- Increased graffiti points from 500 → 1500.

Hopefully this makes the game more balanced between tricks and cleaning, while also making it clearer why you are getting points.

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 13, 2025)
notes.content: - Small bug fixes.

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 13, 2025)
notes.content:
- Daily top 3 leaderboard added to level select.
- Press X to submit name to leaderboard with controller.
- Mouse doesn't disappear with controller in main menu.
- Soap respawns in random spots during free mop.

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 12, 2025)

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 12, 2025)

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 12, 2025)

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 11, 2025)
notes.content:

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 10, 2025)

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 9, 2025)
notes.content:

- Improved scrolling in the leaderboard for a smoother experience.

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 9, 2025)
notes.content: - Removed the ability to use certain words in the leaderboards.

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 8, 2025)
notes.content:
- Improved grind mechanic (better vector math which makes a smoother transition and always chooses the rail that the camera is looking at, not the one in front of the player).
- Small physics bug fix.

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 7, 2025)
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]

- Added buckets around the map in Clean Mode to speed up completion and introduce tactical timed cleaning zones.
- Ensured the mop's orientation is always correct for a more consistent gameplay experience.
- Improved control on surfaces around the bowl for smoother movement.
- Made the UI more intuitive in Clean Mode by removing trick scores and multipliers to keep the focus on cleaning.
- Enhanced overall controls and physics for a better feel and responsiveness.

notes.title: Mop Skater - Patch Notes (March 5, 2025)
notes.content:
[b]Preventing Button Mashing[/b]

After watching many of you play and analysing the scores, I realised I needed to prevent button mashing to make the game more competitive and put a focus on the core gameplay loop. Unfortunately due to this change the leaderboards for 'Classic' game modes have been cleared to assure everyone is playing by the same rules. Hopefully you understand and I genuinely hope this makes competition more fair and fun.
